posts.name: Nishant Gupta
posts.cooked:
Despite several complaints, neither OPE nor ET marks are corrected in light of actual instructions given in respective exam or test.
Queries have been explained logically by students but no explanation of provided incorrect marks is given by course team.

RE-OPPE: Wrong marks System Commands
Agreeable!! The question asked for creating hard link in bin but evaluation expected it to be created in src. Yet we’re being told evaluation was correct. It was easy for us to create as expected by evaluation but since the question said otherwise so we were expecting evaluation to be corrected. Moreover we were told all our submissions will be considered and best would be given marks. But we’re directly being given ‘unattempted’ instead of evaluating on the basis of criterias met as per que…
ET: Wrong marks System Commands
Their Instructions and marking systems do not match. Neither in OPPE Noe in ET *Attempt any 13/15 *All ques of 8 marks *Total capped to 100 So if any 13 attempted, and all correct, you get 100/100 Even if one question wrong, total = 96/100 If any 1 questions half right, rest all correct, total = 100 *It’s not conversion of 104 to 100 it’s capped to 100 And now, marks are provided altogether x/120 (%)
ET: Wrong marks System Commands
@22f3001838 capping is not supposed to be aggregation Please refer to ET: Wrong marks - #32 for details. So our percentage considering top 13/15 questions should be taken as it is. Except for if & when it crosses 100. Also @sushil1 sir, please confirm following too: If any question is flagged wrong, will it be given full marks? Or will it be not considered in marking altogether? Scenario 2 should result in total marking for 12 out 14 questions. Please help clarify.

@sushil1 sir kindly help in due consideration.

posts.cooked:
Thankyou for updating the OPE marks
Kind regards
